answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 166507 Country: India Title: Performing Hajj with borrowed Money Question: I am intending to perform Hajj with my wife In-shaAllah, though I am earning good Alhamdulillah, I am not able to save a bulk amount due to various commitments. I am planning to borrow money from my brother to perform hajj and will return him money in installments In-shaAllah. Is it OK to do this? Answer ID: 166507 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 285/226/B=03/1440) If it is interest free debt then there is no harm in taking debt from your brother. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
